access.fullDescription: No approval prompts for this chat. Risky, but fast.
access.autoProjectDescription: File tools inside the workspace run automatically; shell commands still require approval.
access.askDescription: Ask for approval before reading, creating, or editing files and before running commands.
access.question: How should AI actions be approved?

deleteProject.title: Delete project
deleteProject.detailOne: This also deletes 1 chat and all of its messages. This cannot be undone.
deleteProject.detailMany: This also deletes {{count}} chats and all of their messages. This cannot be undone.

models.title: Choose model
models.noneFoundHelp: No usable models found. Check your provider settings and refresh the catalog.
models.accountWideChooseBelow: Account-wide limit; choose the model and settings below
models.catalogMissingNotice: Your session is connected, but the live model catalog is missing.

tokens.contextHelp: This is the current context for this conversation, not your account quota.
tokens.usageHelp: This app-wide total includes all conversations. Per-model usage is shown as measured only when the provider, CLI, or local runtime reports token counts. Estimates are labelled separately.
tokens.quotaHelp: Account quota is separate from model availability. Missing quota telemetry does not mean a model is offline.
tokens.noReportedUsage: No token usage from a completed model response has been recorded yet. The context estimate above is not account usage.

autoMode.title: Auto Mode
autoMode.description: Let a prompter model automatically create the next prompts for the responder model.
autoMode.infiniteHelp: No fixed iteration limit; the prompter still stops automatically when the goal is complete.
autoMode.unlimitedConfirm: Auto Mode has no fixed iteration or token limit. The prompter stops when the goal is complete, but this can use many tokens. Are you sure you want to start?
autoMode.goalPlaceholder: For example, ‘Build a marketing plan for a new app step by step’ — the prompter will steer the chat toward this goal.
autoMode.prompterHelp: Checks whether the goal is complete and otherwise creates the next concrete task.
autoMode.responderHelp: Performs that task in this chat.

welcome.title: Hello, welcome to LLMelt
welcome.text: First we'll check what already works, then set up only the services you choose.

intro.title: All your LLMs in one place
intro.text: Installations never start silently. You choose a provider, the guide opens the official installer or login, then verifies that the connection really works.

scanning.title: Checking services and accounts
scanning.text: We only read provider statuses. Your conversations, files, and existing settings are not deleted.

confirm.title: Already found
confirm.text: “Found” can also mean a CLI still needs a login; we'll handle that in the next steps.
confirm.none: Nothing found yet. That's okay: next, choose what you want to install or connect.

missing.title: What would you still like to set up?
missing.text: Choose “Yes” to go through the installation or login together now.

done.title: LLMelt is ready
done.text: You can reopen provider settings and this guide at any time.

status.chatgptLogin: Sign in in the ChatGPT window that opened. The guide will check your session automatically.

status.antigravityLogin: Complete the Google login in the terminal window that opened.

status.setupStartFailed: The setup step could not be started.

python.title: Python for coding tasks
python.description: Python is optional for chat, but required when a model needs to build and run Python scripts.

steps.validate: The app only accepts an executable that actually returns a Python version.
steps.install: Installation only starts after your click, using the official Python Install Manager.
steps.save: After installation, the executable path is checked again and saved for tool commands.

python.notChecked: Python has not been checked yet.

progress.awaitingLogin: Waiting for the login to be completed

openai.description: ChatGPT Subscription uses a separate secure web session in LLMelt; no API key is needed.

steps.return: Return here; the guide checks the session automatically.

google.description: Gemini uses the Developer API. The API key and read-only Google Cloud quota must be connected to the same project.
